## Page 8

HENG Strategy 2025
7
Heng Leasing and Capital PLC.
"In 2025, HENG is committed to delivering Sustainable Growth through rigorous
credit screening, effective cost and asset quality control, and the strategic
expansion of business opportunities via a robust partner network."

## Page 9

Quality Portfolio Management
8Quality over Quantity: Shift lending policy to prioritize "Quality" over volume growth
(Selective Growth) to build a resilient long-term portfolio.
Tech-Driven Screening: Enhance customer screening processes using Credit Scoring
and Data Analytics for faster and more accurate risk assessment.
Targeted Segments: Focus on high-potential customer segments with good
repayment history, specifically prioritizing Secured Loans.
Heng Leasing and Capital PLC.

## Page 10

LoansOperational & Collection Excellence
9Proactive Collection: Implement proactive debt
collection strategies and close monitoring to maintain
Asset Quality and control NPLs within target levels.
Hub-and-Spoke Model: Adopt a Cluster-based branch
management model to reduce operating costs and
enhance service speed.
Lean Operation: Streamline operational processes by
eliminating redundancies to maximize employee
productivity.
Heng Leasing and Capital PLC.

## Page 11

Strategic Partnership Expansion
10
Local Ecosystem: Synergize with strong local partners (e.g., fertilizer shops,
agricultural cooperatives, local dealers) to directly penetrate farmer and
community customer bases.
In-Store Financing: Expand loan service channels through partner storefronts
(Point of Sales) to reach new customers without the capital expenditure of
opening new branches.
Mutual Growth: Foster a Win-Win business model that ensures mutual growth
with partners and supply chain sustainability.
Heng Leasing and Capital PLC.
